leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize an AbortController instance within an Angular component
Integrate the AbortController signal into an HTTP request using HttpClient
Configure the cleanup function in ngOnDestroy to abort pending requests
Apply the AbortController pattern to prevent memory leaks in component subscriptions
Construct a service method that automatically cancels requests when components are destroyed
Manipulate component state only when HTTP requests complete successfully
Implement error handling for aborted requests to maintain application stability
